marketContract.moneyline: Proportional no-vig American odds. Conditional home probability pH/(pH+pA). Tied actual games excluded under declared two-way tie-void analytical convention; original 3-way forecasts retained.
marketContract.settlementLimitation: Bookmaker identity, contemporaneous quote time and book-specific settlement rules are absent. Full-game including-OT analytical reference, not verified execution/settlement evidence.
marketContract.spread: nflverse spread_line is signed expected home winning margin (positive means home favorite). Home cover iff actual home-away exceeds spread_line; equality push. No spread-to-probability mapping.
marketContract.stakingOrSelection: None; no wagering edge or tradability claim
marketContract.total: Final home+away points including OT; over iff greater than total_line; equality push.
